title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to add custom pages, reports, and queries to Role Explorer (Customizing Role Explorer)
summary: Role Explorer displays content from role centers and can be extended by adding custom pages, reports, and queries to role centers. Enabling 'Show in Role Explorer' on a profile makes its role center content visible in the 'Explore more roles' section.
key_points: Role Explorer shows content from the current user's role center in the Home section and from other role centers when using 'Explore more roles'
Custom pages, reports, and queries become searchable in Role Explorer when added to a role center and the role is enabled
The 'Show in Role Explorer' setting on profile pages controls which role centers appear in the 'Explore more roles' section
Bookmarks provide the simplest way to add custom content to Role Explorer without requiring customization
